result_excerpt:
Implemented the `/date` endpoint per the technical design.

### Added files

**`DateController.java`** — `GET /date` returns the current date as plain text:
- Optional `format` query parameter (Java `DateTimeFormatter` pattern)
- Default format: `yyyy-MM-dd` (e.g. `2026-08-15`)

**`DateControllerTest.java`** — Tests for:
- Default format (`GET /date`)
- Custom format (`GET /date?format=dd/MM/yyyy`)

### Usage

```bash
GET /date                    # → 2026-08-15
GET /date?format=dd/MM/yyyy  # → 15/08/2026
```

The Dockerfile was already present. All Maven tests pass (`./mvnw test`).
